decisions.reason: Report quotes the exact disabled expression in AttachmentChips, states busy is React state local to sibling AttachButton (plugin-dock-chips.js:7 vs line 34), gives the OR truth table: empty occurrences return null before the map, non-plain phase short-circuits true, plain phase (also default) evaluates busy and throws ReferenceError.

Report explains the render exception during the map unmounts the whole dock slot entry via the InputZone error boundary, not just the remove button; the attach button slot and paste survive, and the diagnostic is console-only with no user-facing banner.

Report uses the shipped v0.2.10 line to show busy is pre-existing, flags the feature.diff inconsistency (diff depicts adding || busy while v0.2.10 excerpt says it existed), proposes a data-present plain-phase v0.2.10 baseline mount and rollback/re-add isolation, credits the additional defect that imageItem sits outside the map before record/status are scoped, and explicitly notes the evidence cannot establish when historical users first exercised the failure.

Minimal fix drops the dangling busy read while preserving the phase guard, offers properly owned shared state as an alternative; hardens arrays with record?.items ?? [], DOM with event.target?.closest?.('.remove') (correctly noting !== null alone is wrong), and scopes imageItem into the occurrence callback where record/status are defined.

Proposes mounting the shipped dock component with a SOURCE-matching occurrence in plain phase under an error-boundary spy, asserting chip and remove button render and the boundary captured nothing; explains empty-state-only tests return null before the throwing line and node --check only parses without resolving free identifiers; includes the data-present slot smoke in minimum pre-ship checks.
